subject: Music Production
subcategory: Iconic Albums and How They Were Made
title: Santana's Supernatural
description: A quick win: understand Santana's Supernatural.

hook.text: Carlos Santana had been largely absent from mainstream charts for over two decades.

buildup.text: Clive Davis paired Santana with modern pop and rock artists to create fresh collaborative tracks.

discovery.text: Producer Matt Serletic blended Santana's Latin guitar with contemporary pop production and vocals.

twist.text: Supernatural won nine Grammy Awards in one night, tying Michael Jackson's all-time record.

climax.text: The album sold over thirty million copies and proved collaboration can reignite any career.

punchline.text: A guitar legend's comeback tied the Grammy record.

quiz.question: How many Grammys did Supernatural win in one night?
